reference_fix: In FormatCents only: take the sign off first (if cents < 0 { sign, cents = "-", -cents }) and prefix it: return sign + "$" + ... . 6 changed lines in money.go, no other file.
allowed_extra: Adding test cases for negative amounts in money_test.go (counted separately as test additions, not as unrelated edits).
Changing groupThousands ONLY if the chosen fix passes negative numbers to it and the change is needed for tests to pass (then it is part of the fix).
